chunks: Ibn Muskan narrated from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
“Nothing is slaughtered in the Haram except camels, cattle, sheep, and chickens.”

key_terms.ٱلْحَرَمِ: the sacred sanctuary precinct in which special legal rulings apply

ai.seo_question: What animals may be slaughtered in the Haram according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about what may be slaughtered within the Haram. It restricts slaughter there to specific domesticated animals, indicating a regulated sanctity for the sacred precinct.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2379 - Ibn Muskan narrated from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdullah (as), who said:
"It is not permissible to slaughter in the Haram except for camels, cows, sheep, and chickens."
